title: C1 Milestone 4: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has superado el Milestone 4 del Nivel C1. Dominas las Cleft Sentences, los Discourse Markers avanzados y el vocabulario de élite de Recursos Humanos y M&A. Estás a nivel de un ejecutivo que opera en los mercados globales.

parts.visual:
Repasaremos las lecciones 16 a 19 del nivel C1: 
- Cleft Sentences: It was John WHO signed / What I need IS more time. 
- Advanced Discourse Markers: Furthermore, Nevertheless, Notwithstanding, Consequently, In so far as.
parts.audio: We will review lessons 16 to 19 of the C1 level. Cleft Sentences: It was John who signed. What I need is more time. And Advanced Discourse Markers: Furthermore, Nevertheless, Notwithstanding, Consequently, and In so far as.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos: 
- Human Resources & Talent (Onboarding, performance review, severance, redundant, headhunter, layoff). 
- Mergers & Acquisitions (Merger, acquisition, due diligence, hostile takeover, synergy, leverage, buyout). 
¡El examen más completo de todo el bloque 4 de C1!
parts.audio: We will also evaluate Human Resources and Talent vocabulary: onboarding, performance review, severance, redundant, headhunter, and layoff. And Mergers and Acquisitions terms: merger, acquisition, due diligence, hostile takeover, synergy, leverage, and buyout. This is the most complete test of C1 Block 4!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este examen integral C1.

questions.question: Normal: Mary approved the deal. -> It was Mary ____ approved the deal. (Cleft - persona).
questions.explanation: It was Mary WHO approved... (persona = who).

questions.question: Normal: I need more investment. -> ____ I need is more investment. (What-Cleft).
Sales rose. ____, the team earned their bonus. (Por consiguiente).
The new employee is in the ____ process this week. (Incorporación).
Both companies joined to create a new entity. This is a ____. (Fusión).
The results were poor. ____, the company refused to give up. (Sin embargo).
After the factory closed, 200 workers were made ____. (Suprimidos / Sin trabajo).
questions.explanation: Made redundant = suprimidos (el puesto ya no existe).

questions.question: The competitor launched a ____ takeover, buying shares against the board's will. (Hostil).
Normal: The scandal caused the crisis. -> It was the scandal ____ caused the crisis. (Cleft - cosa).
questions.explanation: It was the scandal THAT caused... (cosa = that).

questions.question: The strategy is risky. ____, it has the potential to triple our revenue. (Además).
Before signing, the law firm spent two months on ____. (Diligencia debida).
She was dismissed and received a generous ____ package. (Indemnización).
Normal: I find the bureaucracy frustrating. -> What I find frustrating ____ the bureaucracy. (What-Cleft, verbo ser).
questions.explanation: What I find frustrating IS the bureaucracy.

questions.question: ____ the high costs, the project was approved. (A pesar de - formal).
questions.explanation: Notwithstanding + sustantivo = a pesar de (muy formal).

questions.question: The main benefit of combining both companies is the expected ____. (Sinergia).
A recruiter specializing in executive positions is called a ____. (Cazatalentos).
Normal: The team made the decision. -> It was the team ____ made the decision. (Cleft - grupo).
questions.explanation: It was the team THAT made... (grupo/cosa = that).

questions.question: The deal ____ was high, given the company's strong brand value. (Valoración del trato).
This proposal is acceptable, ____ it does not exceed the budget. (En la medida en que).
questions.explanation: In so far as = en la medida en que (condición/límite formal).

questions.question: The rate at which employees leave the company and must be replaced is called staff ____. (Rotación).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra o estructura correcta.

questions.question: It was John ____ called. (Cleft - quién)
____ I need is time. (What-Cleft)
____. It is over budget. (Además con F)
____ the risks, we agreed. (A pesar de - formal con N)
Employee ____. (Incorporación con O)
____ package. (Indemnización con S)
A company ____. (Fusión con M)
Due ____. (Diligencia debida con D)
____ takeover. (Hostil con H)
Cost ____. (Sinergia con S)

pairs.source: What I need is more time.
pairs.target: Lo que necesito es más tiempo. (What-Cleft)
